witness_semantics: witness/<aid>.py runs the artifact's solve.py, then independently checks (rules re-implemented from problem.md, no shared code with the artifact): W1 inventory balance with THIS-period production and given init_inv; W2 per-period production capacity; W3 storage over ALL products with true volumes; W4 non-negative inventory; W5 reported objective equals recomputed cost (tol 1e-6).

connection_classes.C1: binding: which variable/parameter a module port reads
connection_classes.C4: time/index: cross-period alignment of a port binding

correct.description: Correct MILP: balance with same-period production; storage sums ALL products with true volumes; integer production/inventory.

c1_bind.description: C1 binding error: the storage constraint reads P2's unit volume as 1 (P1's value) instead of 2. Type-legal, every module locally valid, feasible — but the optimum (48 < reference 50) violates true storage at t1,t2. Detected by W3 and by the suspicious objective gap.

c4_time.description: C4 time/index error: the storage constraint binds next period's inventory inv[t+1] instead of inv[t]. Type-legal, feasible, cheaper (48) — and violates true storage at t1. Detected by W3 and by the objective gap.
